zh: 优化桌面菜单和预览面板的入场动画，滚动看板时自动关闭卡片菜单。
修复平板卡片菜单滚动与任务泳道加载问题，统一详情面板按钮尺寸。
新增多种强调色与手机行内代码配色，改善窄屏配色选项排版。
增大更新说明的版本标题并收紧列表间距，复用 Markdown 样式以减少重复计算。
en: Refine entrance animations for desktop menus and preview panels, and dismiss card menus when the board scrolls.
Fix tablet card-menu scrolling and task-lane loading, and align detail controls with toolbar sizes.
Add more accent and mobile inline-code colors, with better swatch wrapping on narrow screens.
Enlarge release version headings, tighten release-note spacing, and reuse Markdown styles to reduce repeated work.
